analysis.title: US Midterms: Live coverage with Citi
key_insights: Citi expects Democrats to retake the House and favors them to win the Senate, though several pivotal Senate races remain within the margin of error.
The House result should be apparent overnight. The first meaningful Senate swing-state results are expected from 22:00 ET / 03:00 GMT.
Citi's US Economics note says a divided government limits new fiscal policy.

Citi has scheduled client calls for Wednesday, November 4, 2026: a cross-asset first take at 08:00 ET, a macro and energy call at 11:15 ET, and a policy call with Beacon Global Strategies at 14:30 ET.
The note is mainly a pointer to other Citi pieces (equity strategy, US economics, multi-asset strategy, a final markets cheatsheet) and does not give market levels, trade calls or price targets.
risk_factors: Several pivotal Senate races are within the margin of error, so control of the Senate may be uncertain on election night.
Senate swing-state results arrive late in the night (from 22:00 ET), so the full outcome may not be clear before the next day.
geopolitical: US midterm elections on Election Day: Democrats widely expected to retake the House and favored to win the Senate, with several Senate races within the margin of error.
